Classification: High Clan

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} are the king-makers and empire-builders of Caine, descended from the first childe of Enoch. Many identify with the Roman Republic and early Empire, though the fall of Rome to @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} influence still stings when rivals mock them as "Patricians." The clan splinters into rival factions: the highly militaristic Norman @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} following Mithras of England, Hardestadt of Germany seeking to draw power from Paris, merchant-princes building guild and money-lending empires, the Arpad brood of Hungary, and freelance warlords fighting under @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} banners in Iberia. All share a sense of destiny to unite and protect Cainites against the coming Gehenna.

Disciplines: Dominate, Fortitude, Presence

Advantage: All Ventrue begin with an extra Resources Background Trait that can never be permanently lost, plus one Trait of Finance, High Society or Political Influence.

Disadvantage: Ventrue can feed only from mortal blood meeting a particular dietary restriction; any other mortal blood is reflexively regurgitated with no nourishment. This does not apply to vampiric vitae.

Organization: Staunch supporters of the feudal system; most Ventrue are either vassals to greater lords or liege lords themselves.

Suggested Viae: Most strongly identify with the Road of Kings.
